clinical.feedback:
✅ Correct! Kidneys

Function: Bean-shaped, retroperitoneal at T12–L3. Each has ~1 million nephrons. Filter 180L/day, produce 1–2L urine. Regulate fluid balance, electrolytes, acid-base, blood pressure (RAAS).

⚠ Clinical: Kidney disease can disrupt filtration, fluid balance, electrolytes, and acid-base regulation.

modality.before:
🔬 Same slice, three ways
Head · axial · slice 50

The scanner changes what is bright. Read each panel, then decide which scan answers each question below.

CT
X-rays measure density. Bone is bright, air is black, soft tissue sits in a narrow grey band. Takes seconds. Uses ionising radiation.
MRI T1
Magnet and radio waves. Fat is bright, fluid is dark, so soft-tissue anatomy is crisp. Takes minutes. No radiation.
MRI T2
Same scanner, different timing: fluid is bright, so swelling, inflammation and many tumours stand out.
Which scan would you order?
0 / 3
